result_text:
All four payment lists for a period now leave out payments on cancelled invoices. The full test suite passes. I didn't add a test for the Alpha example.

In `DataStore.java` I added `AND i.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to these four queries, the same filter the customer statement already uses:
- `findPaymentsByPeriod` (all payments)
- `findPaymentsByPeriodAndCustomer` (one customer)
- `findPaymentsByRegionAndPeriod` (a region)
- `findPaymentsBySalesRepAndPeriod` (a sales rep's customers)

I left the Javadoc comments on those methods unchanged, so they don't mention the exclusion.

I also left the aggregate queries alone (per-day, per-month, per-rep totals), since the task only covered the four lists.
